languages.localeQualityNote: All 854 source cards lack images; source set ids include SV8/SV8a/SV7/SV10/SV9/SV7a/SV9a/CSMPiC and some names use Traditional Chinese. API locale is zh-cn, but Mainland Simplified Chinese physical printing identity is not verified. Never silently join to the local zh-CN catalogue.

pocketExclusion.rule: Exclude if source card set id is in confirmed Pocket tcgp series setIds (shared across locale), OR image path contains /tcgp/. Preserve physical and missing-image source cards.
pocketExclusion.scopeNote: Chinese Pocket series lookup may return404; shared confirmed English Pocket set ids and image path checks are still applied. A failed series lookup is explicit metadata, not an artist fetch failure.

limitations: Raw illustrator labels are source credit strings, not unique humans; case/spelling aliases are not silently merged.
Card IDs are deduplicated within each language and artist; same card may appear under multiple raw credit labels.
These are provider source cards, not automatically matched to existing TCGHUB printing/holding identities.
Some source cards have no image field; preserve source detail links and do not invent artwork.
Do not include source-only cards in existing local character denominators without independent printing verification.
Current dataset coverage is not a claim of worldwide complete physical cards.
Excluding Pocket establishes a non-Pocket provider scope; it does not independently prove the language, regional release, or exact physical printing of each source card.
